notes.title: Corpse Party gets a new version for 2021 that's out now
notes.notes:
Yes, there's another Corpse Party that's now been released. It can be a little confusing, as there's been a few but this is the latest from XSEED Games titled Corpse Party (2021).

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/10/corpse-party-gets-a-new-version-for-2021-thats-out-now
